blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Friday accused the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) of misinterpreting Ambassador Jing Quan’s remarks that China could “easily win” using force against the Philippines but would not do so. The embassy issued the statement after the DFA said Jing’s comments appeared to convey a “thinly veiled threat of the use of force.” “It is regrettable that the Department of Foreign Affairs has issued such a statement. This kind of selective quotation and overinterpretation demonstrates that there is still a long way to go in fostering effective communication and dialogue between China and […]...
